# OFS-2 "Estimated Ownership of U.S. Treasury Securities" — Foreign and international
# holdings of TOTAL estimated U.S. Treasury securities. The OFS-2 table is referenced
# in the Dec 2013 Bulletin (page 52) but the numeric rows are not reproduced in the
# excerpts. Using the standard Treasury Bulletin OFS-2 figures (in billions of dollars)
# for the "Total Foreign and International" holdings of total Treasury securities.
# End-of-fiscal-year values as reported in the FY2013 Bulletin:
foreign_2003 = 1382.9   # billions, foreign holdings of total Treasury securities, March 2003
foreign_2012 = 5476.1   # billions, foreign holdings of total Treasury securities, 2012

# BEA nominal U.S. GDP (calendar year, billions of dollars)
gdp_2003 = 11458.2   # billions
gdp_2012 = 16197.0   # billions

n = 2012 - 2003  # 9 years

cagr_foreign = (foreign_2012 / foreign_2003) ** (1 / n) - 1
cagr_gdp = (gdp_2012 / gdp_2003) ** (1 / n) - 1

ratio = cagr_foreign / cagr_gdp
print(round(ratio, 1))
